effects.game_extensions: Each game owns its tick, adapter, rendering effects, cleanup, and terminal transitions.
effects.interface_consequence: A scheduler passes bounded delta to a transport-independent game callback.
effects.shared_core: Shared loop infrastructure owns elapsed-frame measurement and the 50 millisecond ceiling.

effects.game_extensions: Games own result construction, terminal phase mapping, diagnostics, fullscreen effects, and host payload shape.
effects.interface_consequence: The emitter accepts a completed result and callback without importing any UI or transport layer.
effects.shared_core: A shared completion latch owns at-most-once delivery for a terminal result.

effects.game_extensions: Games own error copy and all sentence, vocabulary, graph, circle, or target initialization after validation.
effects.interface_consequence: Backend or rules constructors consume a validated nonempty collection before game-specific setup.
effects.shared_core: A shared validation guard owns rejection of empty or blank playable content.

effects.game_extensions: Games own action vocabularies, gesture thresholds, hit regions, and whether an action is currently enabled.
effects.interface_consequence: Rules receive semantic actions and never depend on DOM, pointer, keyboard, touch, or engine event objects.
effects.shared_core: Shared adapters own translation from physical modalities to bounded semantic action identifiers.

effects.game_extensions: Games own count direction, duration, terminal state, secondary health or stability predicates, and threshold effects.
effects.interface_consequence: A pure tick contract returns updated time and a threshold signal to game-owned rules.
effects.shared_core: Shared timing primitives own bounded elapsed or remaining time and threshold detection.

effects.game_extensions: Games own spatial selection, penalties, rewards, combo, trails, mastery, sentence changes, and terminal effects.
effects.interface_consequence: A pure matcher consumes stable target and candidate identity and returns progress without rendering or transport coupling.
effects.shared_core: Shared progression primitives own current-target matching and ordered index advancement.

effects.game_extensions: Games own formula weights, bonus policies, performance dimensions, and zero-attempt treatment.
effects.interface_consequence: A pure calculator accepts normalized performance counters plus an explicit game policy and returns XP.
effects.shared_core: Shared result infrastructure owns typed counters, finite arithmetic, rounding declarations, and optional caps.
